name: rover-esp8266
description: Repo-level tooling: pre-commit hooks shared across firmware (cpp) and frontend (ts).

scripts.format:cpp: find src test -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' -o -name '*.hpp' \) -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format -i
scripts.format:cpp:check: find src test -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' -o -name '*.hpp' \) -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format --dry-run --Werror
